origins.name: Field-Tested
origins.description:
Defeating targets or dealing damage with this weapon gradually increases range, stability, handling, and reload speed.

Swords gain increased charge rate and guard resistance.

perks.name: Closing Time

enhanced.name: Closing Time

perks.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
perks.description: Rapid final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal near the victim's location.

enhanced.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom

perks.name: Master of Arms

enhanced.name: Master of Arms

perks.name: Chill Clip
perks.description: Direct hits with the top half of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.

enhanced.name: Chill Clip
enhanced.description: Direct hits with the majority of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.

perks.name: Discord
perks.description: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

enhanced.name: Discord
enhanced.description: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a longer duration. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Binary Orbit

enhanced.name: Binary Orbit
enhanced.description: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for an improved duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Opening Shot
